name: Vietnam Solar Regulations & Decrees — Decree 135/2024/ND-CP, DPPA Decree 80/2024/ND-CP, PDP8
standard: Decree 135/2024/ND-CP (Self-consumption & Zero-Export Rooftop Solar) + Decree 80/2024/ND-CP (DPPA mechanism) + Decision 500/QD-TTg (Power Development Plan VIII) + Circular 11/2021/TT-BXD + Circular 12/2021/TT-BXD (Cost Norms)
description: Comprehensive legal and regulatory validation for solar PV projects in Vietnam. Covers Decree 135/2024/ND-CP requirements for rooftop solar (self-consumption registration with provincial DOIT or district authorities, maximum 20% surplus power generation cap into the national grid or Zero-Export control requirement, structural roof safety certification, electrical safety inspection). Validates DPPA direct power purchase compliance per Decree 80/2024/ND-CP (virtual or physical PPA with large consumers ≥ 200,000 kWh/month). Validates Vietnamese public construction cost estimation structure per Circular 11/2021/TT-BXD (direct cost, indirect cost, overhead, profit, VAT and contingency).
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
